title: BTS, Cardi B, LE SSERAFIM, Zara Larsson & More: See the Best Photos From 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival
summary: Las Vegas welcomed some of music's biggest names for two nights of epic performances.
contentText:
Las Vegas welcomed some of music’s biggest names this weekend as the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival brought two nights of epic performances to T-Mobile Arena on Sept. 18 and 19.

The annual festival packed its lineup with artists spanning pop, hip-hop, country, rock and K-pop, with BTS , Cardi B , Snoop Dogg , Benson Boone , Ciara , Kenny Chesney , Lainey Wilson , LE SSERAFIM , Muse , The Smashing Pumpkins , Weezer , Zara Larsson and more taking the stage throughout the weekend. The performances ranged from longtime favorites and career-spanning hits to newer acts earning their space on the festival stage.

BTS capped the first night with a set featuring “SWIM,” “2.0,” “MIC Drop” and “FYA,” while Cardi B, Zara Larsson, Weezer and Goo Goo Dolls also brought their biggest songs to the stage. Night 2 opened with Benson Boone, who unsurprisingly incorporated his signature backflips into his performance, before sets from LE SSERAFIM, Muse, The Smashing Pumpkins, Lainey Wilson and Ciara. Wilson also paid tribute to Dolly Parton with a performance of “9 to 5.”

Snoop Dogg closed out the festival on Saturday night, bringing some of his biggest hits to life and even having Wiz Khalifa join him for “See You Again” and “Young, Wild and Free.” Beyond the main stage, Stella Lefty performed at the House of Music before Saturday’s show, while Major Lazer took over the space following the night’s performances.

Scroll through the gallery for a look at the highlights from the high-energy sets from the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival.
